{{Top|leg}}
The '''X-series''' was a line of civilian [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] models manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. The [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder]] was part of the X-series.<ref name="RPG-Core-Rev">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The X-series is identified as the "XP-series" in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]'', and incorrectly refers to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] landspeeder as an "XP-34".<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> This was corrected in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook|revised version]] of the rulebook to the "X-series" and "X-34" respectively.<ref name="RPG-Core-Rev" />
